---
title: "Palmer Penguin Dashboard"
author: "Liliyah-Joy Quel-Kaina"
format: dashboard 
---

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(plotly)
library(palmerpenguins)

penguins <- penguins
```

# Data Graphs

## Row 1

```{r, warning=FALSE}
mass_by_island <- ggplot(data = penguins, aes(x = island, y = body_mass_g)) + 
  geom_boxplot()

ggplotly(mass_by_island)
```

```{r, warning=FALSE}
bill_by_island <- ggplot(penguins, aes(island, bill_length_mm)) + 
  geom_boxplot()

ggplotly(bill_by_island)
```

## Row 2 {.tabset}

```{r, warning=FALSE}
#| title: Flipper Length by Mass

ggplot(penguins, aes(body_mass_g, flipper_length_mm, color = species)) + 
  geom_point()
  
```

```{r, warning=FALSE}
#| title: Bill Length by Mass

ggplot(penguins, aes(body_mass_g, bill_length_mm, color = species)) + 
  geom_point()
```

# Data Table

This data set describes 344 individual penguins and comes from the 'palmerpenguins' package. These three species of penguins lives on the different islands in the Palmer Archipelago.

```{r}

penguins <- penguins |> 
  select(-c(year))

knitr::kable(penguins)
```
